name: ClassMean.exists_invariant_diagonal_form
summary: Multinomial coefficients of degree < k^f divide k^{|σ|f} in O (the k-part of a binomial coefficient C(m, j) with m < k^f is at most k^f, the rest is a unit), so q(γ) = k^{|σ|f}/multinomial(γ) exists (0 in higher degree). The transposition identity follows from the Fock pairing ⟨f, g⟩ = Σ α!f_αg_α, for which linSubst A and linSubst Aᵀ are adjoint, multiplied through by |α|!.

steps.claim: Claim M: for every finite set s ⊆ σ and exponent α with Σ_{b∈s} α_b < k^f, the multinomial coefficient of α on s divides k^{|s|·f} in O.
steps.lean:
have M s α (h : s.sum α < k ^ f) : (@multinomial σ s α : O) ∣ k ^ (#s * f) := by
    induction s using cons_induction <;> simp_all [multinomial_insert, pow_mul', _root_.pow_succ']
    gcongr
    grw [← (Nat.choose ..).ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self, cast_mul, cast_pow, (notMem_maximalIdeal.1
      (Ideal.IsPrime.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem (coprime_ordCompl pp (choose_ne_zero
      le_self_add)).cast hp)).mul_right_dvd, factorization_choose_le_log, h, log_pow pp.one_lt]; lia
steps.typed_fact: (@multinomial σ s α : O) ∣ k ^ (#s * f)

steps.claim: Induction on s: for s = ∅ the multinomial is 1; adding an element a multiplies it by a binomial coefficient C(Σ_{s∪{a}} α, α_a), so it suffices that this binomial coefficient divides k^f.
steps.lean: induction s using cons_induction <;> simp_all [multinomial_insert, pow_mul', _root_.pow_succ']

steps.claim: Compare the two factors (the induction hypothesis handles the multinomial of s).

Write C = k^{v_k(C)}·C' with C' prime to k. C' is a unit of O: k is not a unit, so it lies in the maximal ideal of the local ring O, and C' coprime to k cannot lie there too. And v_k(C) ≤ log_k(Σ α) < f since Σ α < k^f (h); so C divides k^f.
steps.lean:
grw [← (Nat.choose ..).ordProj_mul_ordCompl_eq_self, cast_mul, cast_pow, (notMem_maximalIdeal.1
      (Ideal.IsPrime.notMem_of_isCoprime_of_mem (coprime_ordCompl pp (choose_ne_zero
      le_self_add)).cast hp)).mul_right_dvd, factorization_choose_le_log, h, log_pow pp.one_lt]; lia

steps.claim: For every γ choose q(γ) with k^{|σ|f} = multinomial(γ)·q(γ) when |γ| < k^f, and multinomial(γ)·q(γ) = 0 otherwise (by M for s = σ).
steps.lean: choose q hq using fun γ ↦ iteInduction (M univ γ) fun _ ↦ dvd_zero _

use (q ·), by grind [multinomial_eq_of_support_subset, degree_eq_sum], fun A α β ↦
    nsmul_right_injective α.degree.factorial_ne_zero
    (by grind [degree_eq_sum, by simpa [fockPairing, jet_eq_sum, prod_fintype, -coe_monomial] using
    (fockPairing_linSubst A (monomial α 1) (monomial β 1)), !congr(($(multinomial_spec ..) : O)),
    (Monomials.isHomogeneous_linSubst _ ⟨α, by aesop⟩).coeff_eq_zero])

steps.claim: (i) is hq for |γ| < k^f (the multinomial on σ is that of γ, as its support lies in σ).

(ii): multiply both sides by |α|! ≠ 0 (O has characteristic 0). The Fock pairing gives α!·coeff_α(linSubst A x^β) = β!·coeff_β(linSubst Aᵀ x^α) (fockPairing_linSubst); both coefficients vanish unless |α| = |β| (linSubst preserves degree); and multinomial(γ)·Π γ_b! = |γ|! together with hq gives the identity, both sides being 0 when |α| ≥ k^f.
steps.lean:
fun A α β ↦
    nsmul_right_injective α.degree.factorial_ne_zero
    (by grind [degree_eq_sum, by simpa [fockPairing, jet_eq_sum, prod_fintype, -coe_monomial] using
    (fockPairing_linSubst A (monomial α 1) (monomial β 1)), !congr(($(multinomial_spec ..) : O)),
    (Monomials.isHomogeneous_linSubst _ ⟨α, by aesop⟩).coeff_eq_zero])
